sections.label: Re-employment offers at 62 and 65
sections.summary: In 2015, over 98% of local employees who wished to continue working were offered re-employment at ages 62 and 65.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In 2015, over 98% of local employees who wished to continue working were actually offered re-employment upon reaching the ages of 62 and 65.

sections.label: Raising re-employment age to 67
sections.summary: The re-employment age will rise from 65 to 67 by 1 July 2017, with Special Employment Credit and WorkPro support for employers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: First, we will raise the re-employment age from 65 to 67 by 1 July 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will also support employers with Special Employment Credit of up to 11% of wage offset when they employ workers aged 65 and above.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We fund companies to implement age-friendly workplace practices through WorkPro.

sections.label: Gender-neutral help for older workers
sections.summary: Tripartite partners take a gender-neutral approach so older workers beyond 62 and 65 keep working, with 98% re-employed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: The approach taken by the tripartite partners has been that we will take a gender-neutral approach in helping older workers to continue working beyond 62 and 65.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: So far, the programme, activities and strategy have been working reasonably well, in the sense that older workers beyond 62 and 65, including both genders, male and female, 98% of them are able to continue working and get re-employed by the employers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: One of the challenges is to how to better reach out to older workers, particularly the female older workers.

sections.label: Wage offset through Special Employment Credit
sections.summary: Wage offset manages manpower cost through the Special Employment Credit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: First, it is the wage offset to manage the manpower cost.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: We do this through the Special Employment Credit, which I mentioned in my reply just now.
